title: Generating Pretraining Tokens from Organic Data for Data-Bound Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2605.17849v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM pretraining is shifting from a compute-bound to a data-bound regime, where available human (organic) text falls far short of scaling demands. However, reaching the data-bound regime does not mean the model has fully utilized its organic corpus. In this paper, we introduce SynPro, a synthetic data generation framework that helps LLMs more thoroughly learn from limited organic data. SynPro applies two operations, rephrasing and reformatting, that present the same organic source in diverse forms to facilitate deeper learning without introducing external information. Both generators are optimized via reinforcement learning with quality, faithfulness, and data influence rewards, and are continuously updated as pretraining plateaus to target content the model has yet to absorb. translated_title: 从有机数据生成预训练标记以应对数据受限的扩展
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）预训练正从算力受限转向数据受限的状态，即可用的人类（有机）文本远远无法满足扩展需求。然而，进入数据受限状态并不意味着模型已经充分利用了其有机语料库。在本文中，我们提出了 SynPro，一个帮助 LLM 从有限的有机数据中更彻底学习的合成数据生成框架。SynPro 应用了两种操作——改写和重新格式化——以多样化的形式呈现相同的有机数据源，从而在不引入外部信息的情况下促进更深入的学习。这两个生成器均通过强化学习进行优化，奖励包括质量、忠实性和数据影响力，并且随着预训练进入平台期而持续更新，以针对模型尚未吸收的内容。我们使用 DCLM-Baseline 数据集中 Chinchilla 最优标记数的 10%（0.8B、2.2B 和 4B）对 400M、1.1B 和 2B 模型进行预训练，反映了现实的数据受限场景……
tldr: SynPro 框架通过对有机数据进行改写和重新格式化并利用强化学习优化生成器，帮助 LLM 在数据受限时更充分地利用有限的有机数据，且不引入外部信息。
en_tdlr: SynPro is a synthetic data generation framework that helps LLMs more thoroughly learn from limited organic data by rephrasing and reformatting, with generators optimized via reinforcement learning using quality, faithfulness, and data influence rewards.
